learning_outcomes.text: Effective use of information sources and resources of communication and assisted professional training (Internet portals, specialized software applications, databases, online courses, etc.) both in Romanian and in a language of international circulation.
Improve English knowledge to reach the level of language competence that would allow students to understand and produce accurate academic and scientific texts in English.
Understand written or verbal texts on topics related to the field of engineering in general and the chosen specialization in particular.
Produce written texts or express oneself verbally in English.
Acquiring field-related vocabulary in English and the completion of documents that are specific to the chosen field of study.

syllabus_topics: Computer Modeling and Software Used in Electrical Engineering. Reading and Speaking
Computational electromagnetics (electromagnetic modeling): FDTD, FEM, BEM. Writing exercises.
Systems and Control Theory. Reading and Speaking.
Basic Control Structures. Reading and Speaking
Modeling, Identifying and Simulating Systems. Reading and Speaking
Quality in Engineering. Reading and Speaking
Engineering Ethics and Responsible Technology. Reading and Speaking
Computing and Ethics. (Vocabulary concerning the topics of ethics and legislation in the field of computers in the context of using the Internet)
E-cycling in the context of Recycling. Debates on the chosen theme
Quality in Engineering. Reading and speaking.
Starting a Career in the field of Electrical Engineering. Writing a CV and a Letter of Application. Writing exercises.
Preparing for a job-interview. Speaking exercises.
teaching_methods: free exposition with presentation of materials on the board
assessment_rules: The evaluation can be done face-to-face or online. For a passing mark (5), students must know the fundamental notions required in the subjects without presenting details. For a mark of 10, thorough knowledge of all subjects is required. Minimum performance standards include the capacity to use English appropriately, produce written documents discussed during seminars, and use accurate grammatical structures.
